programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery and bloodshed.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty

programme.title: Antim Nyay

programme.title: Laila

programme.title: Race

programme.title: Blackmail

programme.title: Khel

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Osprey
programme.desc: When a veteran pair of osprey return home, they must take on enemies, elements and hundreds of fish if they wish to raise the next generation.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands With...

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands With...

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands With...

programme.title: Attenborough's Flying Monsters

programme.title: David Attenborough's...
programme.desc: ...Natural History Museum Alive. To celebrate Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday, join him on an after-hours stroll around the British institution as its wonders come to life.

programme.title: Africa's Claws And Jaws

programme.title: Shark Squad

programme.title: Accidental Wilderness: Europe's Everglades
programme.desc: It was once a former wasteland where an entire city's wastewater used to be deposited. Now, it's a paradise for birds migrating from across the continent and beyond.

programme.title: Rewilding
programme.desc: Return Of The European Bison: Europe's biggest terrestrial mammal was hunted to extinction, but thanks to ambitious rewilding, the European Bison has been re-introduced. (S1, ep 1)

programme.desc: Albert, Herbie and Quincy: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programme.desc: Rocco, Harold and Cindy: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard, the penguin and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Baby Animals

programme.title: Baby Animals

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Some snapping turtles are ready to be released back to the wild. Meanwhile, a milk snake comes in with a cat bite, and an injured opossum is found in a park. (9 of 12)

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Meet a flock of cedar waxwings who have taken over the centre's aviary and are keeping the staff busy with endless demands for food! (10 of 12)

programme.title: The Wild Wild East

programme.title: High Life In The Dead Mountains

programme.title: New Kids In The Wild
